name: Antepia Restaurant und Hotel
kurzbeschreibung:
**Antepia Restaurant & Hotel in Kufstein**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of **Kufstein**, where tradition meets modern comfort. At **Antepia**, we invite you to savor the finest flavors of the **Alps**, from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all crafted with local ingredients.

Our cozy hotel offers stylish rooms with breathtaking views of the **Kaisergebirge** mountains—perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes. Whether you’re craving a gourmet dinner or a warm cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup, **Antepia** promises an unforgettable experience in the charming town of **Kufstein**.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our location makes us an ideal base for adventure—whether you’re hiking the **Zillertal** trails, skiing in **Wildschönau**, or strolling through **Kufstein Fortress**.

Welcome to **Antepia**—where every visit feels like coming home.
